subject: Marigold Retail AP onboarding & PO requirements
messages:
From: Elise Brown <elise@marigold-retail.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@marigold-retail.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor registration & PO billing rules

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking the call earlier — Marigold is ready to onboard Redwood Inference as a supplier in our AP system. Before we send the vendor portal invite, AP needs the following so we can generate POs and ensure payments are routed correctly: 

- Legal name (as appears on W-9 / VAT docs)
- Tax ID / VAT number and country of issuance
- Bank routing details (IBAN + SWIFT for EUR payments)
- Standard invoice layout and where the PO number should appear on the invoice (header vs. line item)
- Remit-to email for electronic invoice submissions (Peppol / SFTP info if available)
- Default payment terms (we use PO-level Net30 unless otherwise agreed)

I attached a short AP intake form for your vendor team — if you can complete and return that, we can push the portal invite. Also, please confirm whether you accept split payments and electronic credit notes.

If we can get the packet back by end of week we will issue the first PO for the pilot order.

Thanks,

Elise Brown
Head of Procurement Operations
Marigold Retail
Attachments: Marigold_AP_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: New vendor registration & PO billing rules

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Marigold's AP intake. Can you take the lead on this? Quick checklist I think we need to confirm before sending back: 

- Legal entity name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (confirming capitalization, legal suffix)
- US TIN: 12-3456789 (we have W-9 on file — see attachment candidate)
- EU VAT: We do not have an EU VAT registered entity; Marigold is asking because some orders could be for EU warehouses — need guidance on whether to include our reseller partner VAT or request reverse-charge. Rishi, can you advise?
- Banking: we should prefer wire in USD for initial pilot, but include IBAN/SWIFT for EUR as backup. Marcus has the bank letter; Marissa, can you attach the bank confirmation and W-9 draft?
- PO placement: Elise asks whether PO should be on header. Our standard invoice generator puts PO number in header and on each line; need to confirm template with AP.
- Split payments: we usually accept them but need to ensure partial invoice matching for GS1 line items.

Action items: Marissa, prepare a completed Marigold_AP_Form.xlsx, include our standard invoice PDF (with sample header), and attach W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf. Rishi, please advise on VAT approach for EU shipments (reverse-charge vs. partner invoicing).

I'll reply to Elise once we have the packet.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: New vendor registration & PO billing rules

Thanks — attaching the completed intake and the invoice sample. Notes: 

- Attached: Marigold_AP_Form.xlsx (filled), Marigold_PO_template.pdf (sample invoice showing PO in header), W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf
- Banking: our treasury confirms USD wire details are primary; IBAN/SWIFT provided for EUR. See bank_confirmation.pdf placeholder (we'll include actual bank letter in the portal).
- PO handling: our billing system requires the PO in the invoice header to automatically map to the AR workflow. If the PO is only on a line item, we need a manual step and that delays processing. Recommend requesting header PO placement.
- VAT: Rishi — recommended language for external reply: "For Marigold orders shipped within the EU we expect reverse-charge to be applied where applicable; where Marigold requires supplier VAT registration we can evaluate using a local reseller for those specific country shipments."
- Split payments: confirm we accept split payments but need PO-level note that partial shipments will be invoiced individually with matching delivery notes.

I'll also add a short bullet list of required fields for their portal: legal name, tax id, remit address, payment terms, contact email for invoice exceptions.

Marissa Cole
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Marigold_AP_Form.xlsx (completed), Marigold_PO_template.pdf (pdf), W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (pdf)

Hi Elise — thanks for the checklist. Please find the completed intake and supporting docs attached. Summary below so AP has everything in one place: 

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (US TIN) — W-9 attached
- EU VAT: Redwood does not operate a VAT-registered legal entity in EU; for EU shipments we request reverse-charge. If Marigold policy requires a supplier VAT for local POs we can discuss using a local reseller partner for those transactions.
- Bank details: USD wire preferred; IBAN/SWIFT included in the bank confirmation file.
- Invoice layout: PO must appear in the invoice header to allow automated PO matching (attached sample). We also echo the PO number in line items when provided.
- Payment terms: Standard Net30 unless otherwise noted on the PO.
- Split payments: Accepted. Please include 'partial shipment' note on PO so our AR can match partial invoices to the correct PO lines.

Attachments: Marigold_AP_Form.xlsx, Marigold_PO_template.pdf, W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (all are attached as stubs in this thread). If you prefer to issue a portal invitation, our vendor contact for the portal is finance-ops@redwood.ai.

Next steps from Marigold: portal invite + initial PO for pilot SKU. From our side we'll confirm the first invoice reference once the PO is visible.

Best regards,

Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
